The therapist was skilled and the massage technique was effective—helped ease muscle tension and felt professionally delivered.

However, the overall environment fell short of expectations. The headrest pillow was too firm, causing neck strain while lying face down. There was no sauna included, and the shower and therapy room need better upkeep. Water was leaking from the A/C in my room, and there was a faint squeaking noise from outside or a neighboring room, which disrupted the ambience. For a spa experience to feel truly relaxing, comfort and maintenance are just as important as the massage itself.

Decent for the massage quality, but the space needs improvement to justify the price and deliver a more rejuvenating experience.

I have been a member of Elite Luxury Spa for over 2 years but I have been to Malad outlet only twice because of the kind of therapists they have and the kind of customer service that they give.

I told them about all my requirements and needs, they agreed and said will convey it to the therapist and give me the best one that is available.

What is more disappointing is that, the receptionist rather than asking me about my experience or apologising to me for the error made by the therapist, she is saying ‘If I would have known that you would take this long, I would have refunded your money and asked you to leave’.
I mean, are you serious?

I understand that it is your closing time and everything but 10 mins hardly makes a difference especially when you want to retain a customer.

The arrogance that staff have at this particular location is beyond comprehension.
I feel that I wasted my hours here today because the therapy was terrible and the customer service even worse.
